observations: At 1280, 800, 390 and 320 pixels the activity follows all six existing entry choices, retains the exact admitted headline and text, and introduces no horizontal overflow or overlap.

The compact bordered link remains readable at 320 pixels. The Daily column cards use Jost without uppercase transformation; their bordered links remain visible, and the footer no longer forms a dark box.

blockingFinding.title: The Homepage activity link does not open the advertised column
blockingFinding.source: scripts/build-newsstand-derivatives.mjs emits dailyActivity.url as /newsstand?daily=2026-09-11 and content/site/newsstand-home-preview-v1.js copies that URL to the boxed link.
blockingFinding.observedJourney: At 390 pixels, clicking Read today’s Daily navigated to https://laidies.ai/newsstand?daily=2026-09-11. After four seconds the page remained data-paper=daily, with zero .ns-service-article nodes. The exact activity was therefore not open.
blockingFinding.existingCorrectRoute: content/site/newsstand-catchup-v1.js columnHref(id) opens a service record with ?column=<recordId>; renderColumn then sets data-paper=service and binds the article to data-column-id.
blockingFinding.smallestRepair: Emit and validate the exact same-origin column URL for dailyActivity, then extend the Homepage browser test to click the boxed link and require data-paper=service plus data-column-id equal to dailyActivity.id. The current test only compares the href to the defective feed value.

limitations: Native assistive-technology behavior was not reviewed because the Mac remained locked; keyboard focus styling and DOM labeling were inspected in source and browser only.
No public deployment or canonical data mutation was performed by this reviewer.
rationale: The visual, hierarchy, suppression, date-rollover and privacy requirements pass, but the primary boxed action does not open the activity it advertises. Release should wait for the exact column-route repair and one fresh independent click journey on the successor bytes.
